Application Data.NAME: StitchCraft Fabrics
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: StitchCraft Fabrics specializes in the retail sale of high-quality fabrics, sewing supplies, and notions for hobbyists and crafters. We offer a wide range of products, including quilting fabrics, apparel fabrics, and home décor materials, alongside a curated selection of sewing patterns and tools. Our store hosts regular workshops and classes, led by certified instructors, designed to teach various sewing techniques and promote safe handling of fabrics and equipment. While we do not provide sewing machine repairs, we prioritize safety and conduct employee training to ensure a secure shopping environment. We have implemented fire prevention measures and maintain secure storage for any chemicals used in the store, in compliance with local regulations. Our online sales represent less than 50% of total revenue, and we have a robust cybersecurity policy in place to protect customer information.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2022, a water leak from the ceiling caused damage to the fabric display section, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The claim was processed and settled with the insurance company. The issue has been resolved, and preventive measures have been taken to ensure that all water pipes are routinely inspected. No further claims have been made since this incident.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Grade A, UL Listed Safe; Class B, Fire Rated, 1-hour protection; Combination lock with key backup.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fence surrounding the property; 24/7 central station alarm system; regular patrol by hired security personnel during business hours.
